$comment: The register of every place personal information goes. Read by docs/privacy/transfers.md and by scripts/privacy-register.test.mjs, which fails when deploy/digitalocean/dev.app.yaml or lib/env.ts adds a store, a host, a provider or an environment variable of a data context that is not listed here. Facts from the code and the deployment spec only; null = not stated in the code. Each entry also carries usedInProduction, retention and agreement: a production start is refused (productionProblems) while a used entry's where, retention or agreement is null, empty or 'not stated'.

entries.role: PostgreSQL database (accounts, document records, analyses, audit)
entries.where: Toronto (region tor, next to the app: the spec header and lib/env.ts)
entries.retention: Per data type, by the retention policies (apps/web/lib/retention.ts, docs/privacy/retention.md)

entries.role: Kept documents in development (fictional data only; refused in production by productionProblems)
entries.provider: Bunny Storage, private zone yomizaka-docs-dev, token-authenticated pull zone
entries.where: New York (ny.storage.bunnycdn.com); the pull zone is a CDN, whose edges the code does not limit to Canada

entries.role: Kept documents in production, or a workspace's own bucket (adapter ready; no bucket is created without the owner's go, ADR-0007)
entries.provider: DigitalOcean Spaces (S3), or an S3-compatible endpoint the customer gives
entries.where: Toronto (tor1) for Krizaka's; the customer's choice for a workspace's own (its region is shown to the customer)
entries.retention: Per data type, by the retention policies (apps/web/lib/retention.ts, docs/privacy/retention.md)

entries.role: Kept documents in the person's own cloud (Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive), once they connect it from Settings > Storage: the documents they choose to keep, in a folder of this app only; the sealed refresh token stays here, never the password
entries.provider: The cloud the person connected: Dropbox, Google Drive or Microsoft OneDrive (OAuth 2.0 with PKCE; the app's folder or files it creates only)
entries.where: The provider's own infrastructure under the person's own account with it; the location is theirs to judge and is not stated by this service
entries.retention: The files stay in the person's own cloud; only the sealed refresh token is kept here, forgotten on disconnect (docs/privacy/transfers.md)
entries.agreement: The provider's own terms, accepted by the person with their own account (docs/privacy/transfers.md)

entries.role: Outgoing e-mail (verification and e-mail change links, sharing notices): the recipient's address and the message
entries.where: api.mailgun.net, the provider's default endpoint; the location of its servers is not stated in the code or the spec

entries.role: Payments and invoices: the account's e-mail, the plan, the payment events
entries.where: The provider's; not stated in the code or the spec

entries.role: The analyses: the text of the document a person asks to check is sent to the engine; the run id is kept
entries.where: Development: DigitalOcean App Platform, Toronto (Sovkora docs/DEPLOY_DEV.md). Production: the tor1 VPC is described (Sovkora docs/DEPLOY_PROD.md) but the production place is not stated until the Sovkora lane confirms it
entries.retention: 30 days for a run (Sovkora retention.sensitive-run-days default for the SENSITIVE document-validation pack; an installation may lower it, never raise it): docs/legal/review-pack.md section 4.3

entries.role: The model the engine calls for judgment questions only (QC-LEASE-010, QC-LEASE-011, document type tie-break); Verikora never calls a model
entries.provider: DigitalOcean serverless inference (inference.do-ai.run), configured in Sovkora's development; the production provider is not stated
